description: The WAARNG located at Camp Murray, WA 98430 intends to award a Firm Fixed Price purchase order by other than full and open competition. Only one source and no other source will satisfy agency requirements. This notice is not a request for competitive proposals. Award will be given to Blazar Technology Solutions, LLC, for the Washington Army National Guard. A determination not to compete this procurement was made because only one responsible source and no other source will satisfy agency requirements to provide installation and integration of specialized NUTANIX software/hardware currently in place. Questions should be directed to Mr. Saul Resendez via email to: saul.resendez.civ@mail.mil.
